_source: The real MapLevelProgress sheet's header row (same layout as config/general/remote-sheet-columns.json, which the live Remote Data tab reads) — kept as a separate schema since this one drives the bundled, point-in-time snapshot (config/level-data-snapshot.csv) loaded at app startup instead of a live Sheets API read.
_note: Column letters are 1-based spreadsheet notation (A, B, ... Z, AA, ...). startRow is the first 1-indexed row real data begins at — rows before it (title/category/header rows) are skipped outright. Any row past that whose Level column still isn't a positive integer, or whose Map column doesn't match a known map, is also skipped. A row whose Customers column is blank is treated as not yet authored and excluded (matches the old per-map levels.json's convention of only bundling data-ready levels).
